user_query: My company is organizing a music event and we need to create a playlist with the greatest hits of all time. Can you provide a playlist from Deezer that features songs from the Hot 100 Artists chart? Additionally, recommend some popular songs from the Switzerland Songs chart.

TaskList.description: Query Deezer API to fetch the playlist of greatest hits from the Hot 100 Artists chart.
Query Deezer API to fetch popular songs from the Switzerland Songs chart.
Combine the results from both API queries to create a final playlist.
